 🚨 Elche-Betis: Pellegrini makes up to five changes at the Martínez Valero 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Elche CF and Real Betis Balompié have revealed their line-ups for Sunday's LALIGA opener at 14:00 at the Martínez Valero.
 It is a high-stakes encounter: the visitors are chasing three points to strengthen their European ambitions, while the hosts urgently need points to pull away from the relegation zone.
 OneFootball Videos
 Elche head into matchday 12 needing to make a statement in front of their home fans. Dituro will be in goal, with Rubén S., Víctor Chust, Redondo and Revivo tasked with keeping Betis' attacking threats at bay.
 In Elche's midfield, Morcillo, Ali Houary, Martim Neto and Lucas Cepeda will be responsible for distributing the ball. Up front, the partnership of Fer Niño and Germán Valera will be tasked with finding the net and turning their team's form around.
 Meanwhile, Manuel Pellegrini's Real Betis take to the pitch determined to maintain their excellent form. With Álvaro Valles firmly established between the posts, the back line will consist of Héctor Bellerín, Marc Bartra, Natan and Fran García.
 Marc Roca and Pablo Fornals will steer Betis' midfield, leaving Isco Alarcón to pull the strings. In attack, Antony, Ez Abde and striker Troy Parrott provide plenty of firepower.
